coverage.scope: Full authored final plus original brief/frozen plan, nine BRS units and scope/non-goals; admitted own-arm draft/critique and captured primary bytes only.
coverage.counting_rule: Counts describe finite reviewer inventories, not atomic propositions or exhaustive opportunity recall. Top-level requirements = O1-O6 plus nine units and two contexts. Owner decision groups, claim groups and criticism groups are nested diagnostic inventories and are not added to the top-level count. ASSESSED does not mean the candidate satisfies an obligation.

axes.name: Original obligations and full plan/owner decisions
axes.rationale: All O1-O6, nine units and two contexts compared; E02 fixed-choice deferral and E03 recovery entry/order prevent full satisfaction.

axes.name: Consequential claims, conditions and versions
axes.rationale: Primary immutable code supports most claims, but E01 conflates the ordinary files-from glob path with direct/verbatim/raw target filtering.

axes.name: Bounded discovery, mechanisms, alternatives, negative and opportunity coverage
axes.rationale: Useful Restic/AWS/Borg knowledge and alternatives survive. No exhaustive opportunity recall, comparative experiment, or independently established discovery-before-plan chronology.

axes.name: Incorrect corrections/rejections or false already-covered dispositions
axes.rationale: Critic corrections are valid; E02/E03 remain false deferred/already-covered comparisons. No unsupported rejection of Borg or AWS adoption found.

axes.name: Draft-critique-final preservation
axes.rationale: Seventeen criticism/disposition groups preserved, including limits and options; inherited errors are not made true by preservation. Family provenance is not scientifically inferred.

axes.name: Proposed versus executed validation and witness applicability
axes.rationale: Eight future acceptance groups and all proof boundaries inspected. No executed PM/Restic witness supplied or claimed; code tests are assertions, not results.

O1_O6.rationale: Beyond reference engine: AWS restore testing/content-time validation and Borg depth/repair alternative. Discovery chronology is reported, not independently established.

Real issue, merged fix, tests and release are present; reported ordinary files-from condition is not covered by the traced tagged tests/filter path (E01).
Every named unit row exists, but E02/E03 and several reference-only limitations defeat claimed complete decision-level comparison.
Substantive supplied critique and seventeen visible dispositions survive. Candidate-family identity/dispatch is unverified host provenance, not source truth.

limitations: No exhaustive public opportunity recall or performance/platform/implementation validation.
Discovery chronology and flash-family dispatch provenance are not independently established from scientific inputs; no SourcePASS inferred from identity/delivery.
Visible arm/path and artifact/procedure structure can reveal method; no other-arm result/score/cost/speed/target/parent analysis/evaluator answer consulted.
Absent adjacent owner documents are dependencies, not assumed defects.
